headline: SKS Advisor, Lex Consult act on LiLLBUD fundraise
sum: LiLLBUD has secured investments from a fundraise led by Zeropearl VC, with participation from angel investors Abhishek Bansal (CEO of Shadowfax) and Kunal Shah (Founder of CRED). SKS Advisor advised LiLLBUD on this fundraise.
detail: LiLLBUD has secured investments from a fundraise led by Zeropearl VC, with participation from angel investors Abhishek Bansal (CEO of Shadowfax) and Kunal Shah (Founder of CRED). SKS Advisor advised LiLLBUD on this fundraise. The transaction team consisted of Vaishali Jethi (Associate) and Deepak Patel (Associate). Lex Consult advised lead investor Zeropearl VC on this fundraise.
